column2: Treachery at San Marco!

Your treasonous vassal, Lord Orso of [d_venice.GetName], has hatched a dastardly plot killing your lover Francesc with his conspirators! As you weep on your throne your marshal, [Root.job_marshal.GetTitledFirstName], and the rest of the consul have gathered before you loyal and true to bring justice to [k_lombardy.GetName] and your late husband's name. "Giustizia per Francesc!" rings across [k_lombardy.GetName],as you gaze eastward with a lit fire in your eye.

Lord [d_venice.Holder.GetName]... your conspirators come to you pleased by the quick work done to the former King of [k_lombardy.GetName] war raging in the [d_veneto.GetAdjective] countryside, your spymaster, [Root.job_spymaster.GetTitledFirstName], and the rest of the consul have gathered before you loyal and true to bring retribution to [k_lombardy.GetName] and make a great name for yourself and your house. "Giustizia per Francesc!" they may scream across [k_lombardy.GetName], you don a bauta with a snarky grin as you march your troops west to meet your former lieges army...
My dear you shall be avenged!
You are filled with grief and anger...
Oh this game has just begun!
Your ambition grows...
[k_lombardy.GetName] Knows Justice!

The cowardly Orso stands chained in his cell, your dungeon master catching him scurring away in a gondola when [c_venice.GetName] fell to your forces. You watch the worm wringle and plea. Ignoring him you search deep within you for guidance of your late husband and like a the clouds parting you hear...

You are chained to the wall of a cell disgraced written upon you and your house for your treachery. The Royal forces caught you escaping and now you behold the wench. She watches over you with an unbreaking stare of disdain, but you can't help but taunt her with memories of her late husband. As the guards come closer you, the Queen suddenly opens to give her judgement...
...Let his cowardly house be forever besmirched.
...He is but a dog in need to be put down.
The Queen shall surely have my head!
The Treachery of [d_venice.GetName]!

The cunning Orso stands victorous, you congratulate yourself, your conspirators standing before you holding the crowns of [k_venetia.GetName] before you. You eagerly grab the crown and begin the slow precession in the ancient streets of [c_venice.GetName] as a festival is dedicated to your cunning.
Will my ambitions reach never cease?
You become King of [k_venetia.GetName]...
In the Shadows of [e_romania.GetName]
It is my Destiny...
Dragan's Throne is Mine!

[Root.GetTitledFirstName], King of [k_bessarabia.GetName], you and the other Generals rode to the corners of the disintegrating Empire of Romania to lay claim on the legacy of Dragan's Great Domain. Upon your great liege's fall into the River Dnieper, you and your host rode into [c_chisinau.GetName] to let the great nobles know the horrible news. Enamoured by your clear and beautiful voice you read the deeds of your late liege before the council of Elders whom recognize you as their liege above the other cravenous generals whom are now your rivals for the Throne. You stand before the crowd you feel the chill of your colors fading away upon thinking of your late liege...
Numa Numa iei...

[Root.GetTitledFirstName], King of [k_dobruja.GetName], you and your brothers rode to the center of the disintegrating Empire of Romania to lay claim on the legacy of your kin Dragan's Great Domain. Your most famous kin unfornuately fell into the River Dnieper on his campaigns to supress the Cossacks, you and your host rode into Constanta to let the great nobles know the horrible news. Enamoured by your clear ambition and imposing stature read the deeds of your late liege before the council of Elders whom recognize you as their liege above the other cravenous generals whom are now your rivals for the Throne.

Your most famous kin unfornuately fell into the River Dnieper on his campaigns to supress the Cossacks, you and your host rode into [c_bucharest.GetName] to let the great nobles know the horrible news. Enamoured by your clear ambition and imposing stature read the deeds of your late liege before the council of Elders whom recognize you as their liege above the other cravenous generals whom are now your rivals for the Throne.

[Root.GetTitledFirstName], King of the [k_galicia_lodomeria.GetName], you and the other Generals rode to the corners of the disintegrating Empire of Romania to lay claim on the legacy of Dragan's Great Domain. Upon your great liege's fall into the River Dnieper, you and your host rode into [c_lviv.GetName] to let the great nobles know the horrible news. Enamoured by your clear ambition and imposing stature you read the deeds of your late liege before the council of Elders whom recognize you as their liege above the other cravenous generals whom are now your rivals for the Throne.

[Root.GetTitledFirstName], you stand horrified as the legacy of Dragan's Great Domain buckles under the rule of cravenous Generals. Upon your great liege's fall into the River Dnieper, you and your host rode into the Capital to let the great nobles know the horrible news. You solemnly pull the deeds of your late liege before the council of Elders whom recognize you as their liege as you wait in baited breath for the wolves to feast upon the corpse of the Empire.
An Offer of Friendship
Friend or Foe?
A pact of Friendship is established...
The letter is sent one hopes you are met with approval...
No hard feelings right?

In the last century, the fortunes of the Sikhs have been in terminal decline. Once the lords of India from Kashmir to the Deccan, you once vast domain has shrunk slowly but surely until even the Punjab slipped from the grasp of the Sikhs, ravaged by Afghan raiders. Your father was forced to abandon his subjects in Punjab due to internal unrest, but you remember the Ahmadiyya and their caliph, always dependable subjects of the Sikhs. They now lie between you and the Afghans, vulnerable. The Ahmadiyya might not see you as their liege any longer, but perhaps they will accept you as an ally?
A treaty is desirable...
The caliph is of no use to me.

Life has never been easy for the Ahmadiyya Community, even before the Event. You, their caliph, know that better than anyone. Your people have been called heretics, Qadanis, scorned by men of their own country. The Sikhs served as protectors in the past centuries, allowing you to live in peace and even proselytize, but the collapse of the Punjab Governorship has left you on your own against the Afghans and even your own neighbors. Therefore, it comes as a great surprise when an old friend, the young Sikh Emperor,  sends you a message offering his friendship. Should this be taken as welcome initiative or an omen?
We need friends, a treaty it is!
They abandoned us, why trust them now?
My dear friend I would like to inform you that I approve of this alliance
My dear friend I would like to inform you that this proposal, I cannot accept...
A Friend most indeed!
And so it be...
An Offer of Friendship
Friend or Foe?
A pact in song is established...

While you look beyond your palace to the hustle and bustle of your kingdom, you can't help but muse over the time you impressed even the mighty Dragon of the East. Long has your people and the forces of the Chinese Empires have been in equal parts trading and clashing over the future of Dzungaria. In your younger years, your father and you meet with the representatives of the Hong Empire to open trading between your burgeoning realm and the Dragon of the East. In your youth you caught your eyes with the current general and struck a conversation as one often did in those days and from their on you and him locked arms entertaining the halls with a bounty of song and revelry that strengthen your bond with each other. While he is married now he considers you a friend and if so he might bring good words to the far-off Hong Emperors of your merit as an ally of theirs...
A most fruitful venture...
I should no entangle myself to the Dragon.

While you look beyond your fortress to the guards overlooking the Jade Gates of the West, you can't help but muse over the time you met an exceptional native among the frontiers of the Ancient Land of Xinjiang. Long has the Middle Kingdom come to in equal parts trade and clash with the many peoples of the region over the future of Xinjiang. In your younger years, your father had recieved many tributes on behalf of the Hong Empire. In those times an exceptional local caught your eyes, the Daughter of the Former King of Xinjiang and you two were renown for entertaining the halls with a bounty of song and revelry that strengthen the bonds of China with these people. While she is married now she considers you a friend and has reached out to you to form an alliance which can strengthen the western regions from raiders into the Middle Kingdom...
